text: What is the primary indicator of subterranean spontaneous heating in a coal seam?
textHindi: कोयला सीम में स्वतः दहन या आंतरिक ताप का मुख्य प्रारंभिक लक्षण क्या है?
textSantali: ᱠᱩᱭᱞᱟᱹ ᱠᱷᱟᱫᱟᱱ ᱨᱮ ᱟᱡ ᱛᱮ ᱥᱮᱸᱜᱮᱞ ᱞᱟᱜᱟᱣᱜ ᱨᱮᱱᱟᱜ ᱢᱩᱬᱩᱛ ᱪᱤᱱᱦᱟᱹ ᱫᱚ ᱪᱮᱫ ᱠᱟᱱᱟ?
options: Rapid accumulation of water in sumps
Gob stink / sweetish petrolic odor and temperature rise above 60°C
Sudden increase in barometric air pressure
explanation: Gob stink (a paraffinic petrolic odor) caused by low-temperature oxidation combined with local temperature rise is the definitive first indicator.

text: What does the 'P' stand for in the fire extinguisher PASS protocol?
textHindi: अग्निशामक के 'PASS' प्रोटोकॉल में 'P' का क्या अर्थ है?
textSantali: ᱥᱮᱸᱜᱮᱞ ᱤᱬᱤᱡ PASS ᱨᱤᱛ ᱨᱮ 'P' ᱨᱮᱱᱟᱜ ᱢᱮᱱᱮᱛ ᱫᱚ ᱪᱮᱫ ᱠᱟᱱᱟ?
options: Pull the safety pin from the handle
explanation: PASS stands for: Pull pin, Aim at base of fire, Squeeze handle, Sweep side-to-side.

text: How many seconds do you have to don an emergency Self-Contained Self-Rescuer (SCSR)?
textHindi: भूमिगत आपातकालीन एससीएसआर (SCSR) श्वसन उपकरण पहनने के लिए मानक समय क्या है?
textSantali: ᱚᱛ ᱞᱟᱛᱟᱨ ᱨᱮ ᱡᱤᱣᱤ ᱵᱟᱧᱪᱟᱣ SCSR ᱦᱚᱨᱚᱜ ᱞᱟᱹᱜᱤᱫ ᱛᱤᱱᱟᱹᱜ ᱚᱠᱛᱚ ᱧᱟᱢᱚᱜᱼᱟ?
explanation: DGMS safety standards mandate donning and initiating oxygen generation within 20 seconds to prevent toxic CO inhalation.

text: What is the primary function of stone dust barriers installed along mine roadways?
textHindi: खदान की गैलरी में स्टोन डस्ट बैरियर (चूना पत्थर धूल अवरोधक) का मुख्य कार्य क्या है?
textSantali: ᱠᱷᱟᱫᱟᱱ ᱨᱮ ᱫᱷᱩᱲᱤ ᱟᱴᱠᱟᱣ ᱥᱮᱞᱯᱷ (Stone Dust Barrier) ᱨᱮᱱᱟᱜ ᱠᱟᱹᱢᱤ ᱫᱚ ᱪᱮᱫ ᱠᱟᱱᱟ?
options: To suppress and extinguish secondary coal dust explosion propagation flame waves
To filter underground diesel locomotive exhaust
explanation: Stone dust barriers disperse incombustible limestone dust upon shockwave impact, quenching flame fronts.

text: When evacuating a smoke-filled underground gallery, which airway should you follow?
textHindi: धुएं से भरी भूमिगत गैलरी से बाहर निकलते समय किस वायुमार्ग का अनुसरण करना चाहिए?
textSantali: ᱠᱩᱦᱲᱟᱹ ᱯᱮᱨᱮᱡ ᱠᱷᱟᱫᱟᱱ ᱠᱷᱚᱱ ᱚᱰᱚᱠᱚᱜ ᱞᱟᱹᱜᱤᱫ ᱚᱠᱟ ᱦᱚᱭ ᱰᱟᱦᱟᱨ ᱯᱟᱸᱡᱟ ᱞᱟᱹᱠᱛᱤ ᱠᱟᱱᱟ?
options: Intake airway (fresh air supply towards shaft)
explanation: Always evacuate along the intake fresh airway against the fresh airflow direction leading to the surface intake shaft.

text: Which class of fire extinguisher is specifically rated for electrical conveyor drive fires?
textHindi: विद्युत कन्वेयर ड्राइव की आग बुझाने के लिए कौन सा अग्निशामक उपयुक्त है?
textSantali: ᱵᱤᱡᱽᱞᱤ ᱥᱮᱸᱜᱮᱞ ᱤᱬᱤᱡ ᱞᱟᱹᱜᱤᱫ ᱚᱠᱟ Extinguisher ᱴᱷᱤᱠᱟᱹ?
options: Dry Chemical Powder (DCP) / CO2 (Class B & C / Electrical)
explanation: DCP and CO2 extinguishers are non-conductive and safely suppress electrical and flammable liquid fires.

text: What is the maximum permissible Carbon Monoxide (CO) concentration before mandatory evacuation?
textHindi: खदान से तुरंत बाहर निकलने के लिए कार्बन मोनोऑक्साइड (CO) का अधिकतम स्तर क्या है?
textSantali: ᱠᱟᱨᱵᱚᱱ ᱢᱳᱱᱳᱠᱥᱟᱭᱤᱰ (CO) ᱛᱤᱱᱟᱹᱜ ᱥᱮᱴᱮᱨ ᱞᱮᱱᱠᱷᱟᱱ ᱠᱷᱟᱫᱟᱱ ᱠᱷᱚᱱ ᱚᱰᱚᱠᱚᱜ ᱦᱩᱭᱩᱜᱼᱟ?
explanation: Under DGMS regulations, CO concentration exceeding 50 PPM requires immediate alarm and SCSR evacuation.

text: Why must coal dust accumulations along conveyor belts be regularly cleaned and stone-dusted?
textHindi: कन्वेयर बेल्ट के पास कोयले की धूल की सफाई और स्टोन डस्टिंग क्यों आवश्यक है?
textSantali: ᱠᱩᱭᱞᱟᱹ ᱫᱷᱩᱲᱤ ᱪᱮᱫᱟᱜ ᱥᱟᱯᱷᱟ ᱟᱨ ᱪᱩᱱ ᱫᱷᱩᱲᱤ ᱪᱷᱤᱴᱠᱟᱹᱣ ᱦᱩᱭᱩᱜᱼᱟ?
options: To prevent conveyor belt mechanical slippage
To prevent fine airborne coal dust from fueling a catastrophic secondary explosion
To keep the floor dry for haulage trucks
explanation: Dry coal dust with volatile matter >12% is explosive when suspended in air; incombustible dust inerting neutralizes this risk.

text: During underground evacuation, why should you keep one hand on the lifeline cord continuously?
textHindi: निकासी के दौरान लाइफलाइन रस्सी पर लगातार एक हाथ क्यों रखना चाहिए?
textSantali: ᱚᱰᱚᱠᱚᱜ ᱚᱠᱛᱚ ᱨᱮ ᱞᱟᱭᱤᱯᱷᱞᱟᱭᱤᱱ ᱫᱟᱹᱲᱤ ᱪᱮᱫᱟᱜ ᱥᱟᱵ ᱫᱚᱦᱚ ᱞᱟᱹᱠᱛᱤᱭᱟ?
options: To prevent disorientation and guide your team safely in zero-visibility smoke to fresh air
explanation: Tactile cones on lifelines indicate the correct exit direction towards safety when smoke blinds vision.

text: What is the official passing score required for DGMS industrial safety certification?
textHindi: डीजीएमएस सुरक्षा प्रमाणन परीक्षा के लिए न्यूनतम उत्तीर्ण अंक क्या है?
textSantali: DGMS ᱨᱩᱠᱷᱤᱭᱟᱹ ᱥᱟᱠᱟᱢ ᱧᱟᱢ ᱞᱟᱹᱜᱤᱫ ᱛᱤᱱᱟᱹᱜ ᱥᱠᱳᱨ (Pass Mark) ᱞᱟᱹᱠᱛᱤᱭᱟ?
explanation: A minimum composite score of 70% is strictly enforced across Jharkhand industrial competency frameworks.
